measurement.name: North Pacific Current
measurement.range_interpretation: Reported more-than scale for a broadly defined eastward flow band; not a 2000 km point, rigorous lower bound, finite interval, uncertainty or seasonal range.
measurement.geographic_scope: Textbook combined eastward flow south of the Alaskan Stream, from 30°N to some 200 km off the Alaskan coast; exact longitude support and paired flow boundaries unresolved.
measurement.section_orientation: Broad geographic band description; no resolved cross-flow transect or paired velocity edges.
measurement.layer: No fixed depth layer for the broad North Pacific band; adjacent Alaskan Stream upper-kilometer transport context is separate.
measurement.time_convention: Chapter 8 page version March 2005; no observation dates or width climatology assigned. Preface/version-history September 2002 and first edition 1994 are separate publication context.
measurement.boundary_rule: Author describes a broad band of eastward flow more than 2000 km wide; paired velocity cutoff and calculation unresolved.
measurement.source_citation: Tomczak, M. and J. S. Godfrey, Regional Oceanography: An Introduction, chapter 8 The Pacific Ocean, printed p125 / PDF p135, page version 1.1 March 2005; original 1994 Pergamon edition, university-hosted online compilation.
measurement.source_locator: Printed p125 / PDF p135, paragraph beginning No transport estimates, North Pacific passage and alternative Subarctic split discussion; adjacent pp124–126 / PDF pp134–136. PDF pp2,7–9 version/preface/authorship.
measurement.extraction_method: More-than qualifier and combined-flow definition transcribed from visually inspected original textbook page; no map or velocity boundary digitization.
measurement.source_quality_note: Original textbook page reviewed; underlying breadth measurement/calculation unresolved. Broad combined definition differs from schemes separating North Pacific and Pacific Subarctic currents. Source page is March 2005, not a modern observed-width series.
remaining_gates: Recover the breadth method, observation period, layer and paired velocity boundaries.
Resolve compatibility of the source combined-flow definition with narrower North Pacific/Subarctic naming conventions.
Independent scientific admission; no ranked or seasonal dimension, buffer or physical state intersection.

naming_context.source_definition: Combined eastward flow south of Alaska; Kuroshio and Oyashio continuations treated as the same broad current.
naming_context.alternative_definition: Some authors split North Pacific south of about 43°N and Pacific Subarctic Current north of it. Source questions persistence of this separation across basin.

adjacent_stream_context.source_citation: Royer and Emery (1987), cited by textbook; original not acquired in this batch.
